verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a stable OpenAI SDK compatibility layer: you point the OpenAI SDK at Claude by changing the base URL, API key and model name, and the page lists known limitations. However, Anthropic itself scopes the layer as primarily for testing and comparison, not a long-term or production-ready solution, so existing OpenAI tooling works only with caveats. Missing for 10: production-grade OpenAI-compatible endpoint support, documented migration or adapter guides from other providers' SDKs beyond OpenAI, independent or hands-on corroboration of the compatibility layer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible tooling at the platform, or follow a documented migration/adapter path from other providers' SDKs

citations.quote: Anthropic provides a compatibility layer that lets you use the OpenAI SDK to test the Claude API. With a few code changes, you can evaluate Anthropic model capabilities.
This compatibility layer is primarily intended to test and compare model capabilities, and is not considered a long-term or production-ready solution for most use cases.
